mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of the UNRATE series above 7.6% triggers a tightening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not negative despite UNRATE crossing above 7.6%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) proxies over a monthly period indicates expanding economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase > 5% from previous month
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-month rolling window, or returns not positive when both proxies rise.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in FEDFUNDS rates signals reduced policy tightening, enhancing equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not positive despite FEDFUNDS decline in late-cycle regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in CPIAUCSL below 232.34 indicates cooling inflation, reducing market uncertainty and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not negative despite CPIAUCSL falling below 232.34.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in UNRATE below 7.6% signals a strengthening labor market, increasing wage pressures and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not negative despite UNRATE falling below 7.6%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in INDPRO above historical levels during a strong supply growth regime indicates robust production capacity, enhancing corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not positive despite INDPRO rising in strong supply growth regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in GDPC1 above 13,750 suggests expanding consumer demand, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not positive despite GDPC1 rising above 13,750.
